name_original: Olympus - TG-4 16.0-Megapixel Waterproof Digital Camera - Red
description_original: Preserve memories with this Olympus TG-4 16.0-megapixel digital camera that captures sharp photos and 1080p videos and lets you share them via Wi-Fi. The rugged design resists water, freezing temperatures, crushing force, shocks and dust for durability. Memory card sold separately.
